verse.lines: Lord God, Thy praise we sing; Father in eternity, Lord God, our thanks we bring; Angels all and heav'nly host All the world worships Thee. Of Thy glory loudly boast; Both Cherubim and Seraphim Holy art Thou, our God! Sing ever with loud voice this hymn: Holy art Thou, our God, the Lord of Sabaoth! Holy art Thou, our God! Holy art Thou, our God, the Lord of Sabaoth! The universal Church doth Thee Throughout the world confess to be Thee, Father, on Thy highest throne, Thy worthy, true, and well belov'd Son, The Comforter, ev'n the Holy Ghost, Whereof she makes her constant boast. Thee King of all glory, Christ, we own, Th'eternal Father's eternal Son. At God's right hand Thou sittest, clad In th'glory with the Father had; Thy servants help whom Thou, O God, Hast ransomed with that precious blood; Grant that we share the heav'nly rest With the happy saints eternally blest. Help us, O Lord, from age to age, And bless Thy chosen heritage. Nourish and keep them by Thy pow'r, And lift them up for evermore. Lord God, we praise Thee day by day, And sanctify Thy Name always. Keep us this day, and at all times, From secret sins and open crimes; In Thee, Lord, have we put our trust; O never let our hope be lost! Amen. Amen.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Lord God, Thy praise we sing; Father in eternity, Lord God, our thanks we bring; Angels all and heav'nly host All the world worships Thee. Of Thy glory loudly boast; Both Cherubim and Seraphim Holy art Thou, our God! Sing ever with loud voice this hymn: Holy art Thou, our God, the Lord of Sabaoth! Holy art Thou, our God! Holy art Thou, our God, the Lord of Sabaoth! The universal Church doth Thee Throughout the world confess to be Thee, Father, on Thy highest throne, Thy worthy, true, and well belov'd Son, The Comforter, ev'n the Holy Ghost, Whereof she makes her constant boast. Thee King of all glory, Christ, we own, Th'eternal Father's eternal Son. Thou shalt in glory come again, To judge both dead and living men. Thy servants help whom Thou, O God, Hast ransomed with that precious blood; Grant that we share the heav'nly rest With the happy saints eternally blest. Help us, O Lord, from age to age, And bless Thy chosen heritage. Nourish and keep them by Thy pow'r, And lift them up for evermore. Lord God, we praise Thee day by day, And sanctify Thy Name always. Keep us this day, and at all times, From secret sins and open crimes; In Thee, Lord, have we put our trust; O never let our hope be lost! Amen. Amen.

titles.title: Lord I Come Before Your Throne of Grace

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, I come before Your throne of grace; I find rest in Your presence, and fullness of joy. In worship and wonder I behold Your face, Singing what a faithful God have I.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: What a faithful God have I, What a faithful God. What a faithful God have I, Faithful in every way.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Lord of mercy, You have heard my cry; Through the storm You're the beacon, My song in the night. In the shelter of Your wings, Hear my heart's reply, Singing what a faithful God have I.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Lord all sov'reign, granting peace from heav'n, Let me comfort those who suffer With the comfort You have given.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: I will tell of Your great love For as long as I live, Singing what a faithful God have I.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, I come, I confess Bowing here I find my rest Without You I fall apart You're the One that guides my heart

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Lord, I need You, oh, I need You Every hour I need You My one defense, my righteousness Oh God, how I need You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Where sin runs deep Your grace is more Where grace is found is where You are Where You are, Lord, I am free Holiness is Christ in me

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: So teach my song to rise to You When temptation comes my way When I cannot stand I'll fall on You Jesus, you're my hope and stay

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, my heart can grow, so far away and cold; And yet for me Your love is still the same Lord, I bend my knee in awe and fear of Thee My head bowed down in rev'rence to Your name.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: I lift Your name, Your Holy name, Jehovah God, Elohim The Great I Am, the Risen Lamb My Comforter and King.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Lord, my heart's desire is to be filled with the Spirit Fire, My purpose is to worship You alone. Open up my soul to worship and adore, To be a fragrance offered to Your throne.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord I'm grateful, amazed at what you've done My finest efforts are filthy rags But I'm made righteous by trusting in the Son I have God's riches at Christ's expense

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: 'Cause it's grace there's nothing I can do To make You love me more To make You love me less than You do And by faith I'm standing on this stone Of Christ and Christ alone Your righteousness is all that I need 'Cause it's grace

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Called and chosen when I was far away You brought me into Your family Free forgiven my guilt is washed away Your loving kindness is life to me

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Grace loves the sinner Loves all I am and all I'll ever be Makes me a winner Whatever lies the devil throws at me

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Freely given but bought with priceless blood My life was ransomed at Calvary There my Jesus gave everything He could That I might live for eternity

titles.title: Lord Jesus Christ, Very Word of God

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord Jesus Christ, Very Word of God. The Source of Life.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: // At Your name, I will raise my hands, and with all my heart, I will worship you //

authors.author: from William Daman's Psalter, 1579, Synesius of Cyrene (375-430), Chatfield, Allen William (1808-1896)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord Jesus, think on me And purge away my sin; From earthborn passions set me free And make me pure within.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Lord Jesus, think on me, With many'a care oppressed; Let me Thy loving servant be And taste Thy promised rest.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Lord Jesus, think on me Amid the battle's strife; In all my pain and misery Be Thou my Health and Life.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Lord Jesus, think on me Nor let me go astray; Through darkness and perplexity Point Thou the heav'nly way.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Lord Jesus, think on me When floods the tempest high; When on doth rush the enemy, O Savior, be Thou nigh!

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: From the ends of the earth, From the depths of the sea, From the heights of the heavens, Your name be praised! From the cries of the weak, And the shouts of the strong, From the lips of all people, This song we raise, Lord!

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Throughout the endless ages You will be crowned with praises, Lord Most High! Exalted in every nation, Sovereign o'er all creation, Lord Most High, be magnified!

authors.author: from Poitiers Antiphoner, von Löwenstern, Matthäus Apelles (1594-1648), Pusey, Philip (1799-1855)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord of our life, and God of our salvation, Star of our night, and Hope of every nation, Hear and receive Thy church's supplication, Lord God Almighty.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: See round Thine Ark the hungry billows curling! See how Thy foes their banners are unfurling! Lord, while their darts envenomed they are hurling, Thou canst preserve us.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Lord, Thou canst help when earthly armor faileth; Lord, Thou canst save when sin itself assaileth; Lord, o'er Thy Rock nor death nor hell prevaileth; Grant us Thy peace, Lord.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Peace, in our hearts, our evil thoughts assuaging, Peace, in Thy Church, where brothers are engaging, Peace, when the world its busy war is waging; Calm Thy foes raging!

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Grant us Thy help till backward they are driven; Grant them Thy Truth, that they may be forgiven; Grant peace on earth, and after we have striven, Peace in Thy Heaven.

titles.title: Lord Who Throughout These Forty Days

authors.author: from Day's Psalter, 1563, Hernaman, Claudia Frances Ibotson (1838-1898)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, who throughout these forty days For us didst fast and pray, Teach us with Thee to mourn our sins And close by Thee to stay.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: As Thou with Satan didst contend, And didst the vict'ry win, O give us strength in Thee to fight, In Thee to conquer sin.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: As Thou didst hunger bear, and thirst, So teach us, gracious Lord, To die to self, and chiefly live By Thy most holy Word.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: And through these days of penitence, And through Thy passiontide, Yea, evermore in life and death, Jesus, with us abide.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Abide with us, that so, this life Of suff'ring over past, An Easter of unending joy We may attain at last.

titles.title: Lord You Are an Amazing God

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Looking in the sky, whoever could deny Your glory? Gazing into space, how small the human race appears. Seeing You in all Your majesty, I wonder how it could be That You delight in me.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Lord You are an amazing God Lord You are an amazing God Lord You are an amazing God And I love You, I love You.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Lord of everything, no other god or king is like You. Powerful and strong, yet tender is Your song to me. Knowing the extent of all my sin, however could You be pleased To pour Your love on me?

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: You light up the heavens with just one word, You measure the mountains in Your hand; Yet You treasure the broken and make them whole, You crown us with Your love.

verse.name: v1
v2
c1
verse.lines: And I will praise you, Lord. And I will sing of love come down. And as you show your face, We'll see your glory here.

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: And I will praise you, Lord. And I will sing of love come down. And as you show your face, We'll see your glory here.

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: We'll see your glory here. We'll see your glory here.

titles.title: Lord You are always by my side

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: When trouble comes I trust in You For I know You will lead me through And I know You are faithful till the end

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: And when the storms are drawing near When I'm with You I don't have to fear You're my shepherd on whom I can depend

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Through the day, Through the night I trust You'll guide me by Your light

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: Lord You are always by my side You never change, in You I hide You are the same yesterday and today and forevermore Here on your promises I stand You hold my future in Your hand My solid rock, Almighty God, I worship you

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Verse I will come to You with an open heart And bring a sacrifice of praise I have seen Your pow'r in the Holy place And I have known Your mighty ways

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Pre-chorus I will remember Your mercy and Lord Your faithfulness

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Chorus 1 Lord Your goodness and Your love will follow me All the days of my life I'm surrounded with the favour of the Lord always and forever

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Chorus 2 Lord Your goodness and Your love will follow me All the days of my life I'm surrounded with the favour of the Lord Always and forever Always and forever

titles.title: Lord of Glory, Who Hast Bought Us

authors.author: Prichard, Rowland H. (1811-1887), Alderson, Eliza Sibbald Dykes (1818-1889)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord of Glory, who hast bought us with Thy lifeblood as the price, Never grudging for the lost ones that tremendous sacrifice; And with that hast freely given blessings countless as the sand, To th'unthankful and the evil with Thine own unsparing hand.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Grant us hearts, dear Lord, to yield Thee gladly, freely, of Thine own. With the sunshine of Thy goodness melt our thankless hearts of stone. Till our cold and selfish natures, warmed by Thee, at length believe That more happy and more blessed 'tis to give than to receive.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Wondrous honor hast Thou given to our humblest charity. In Thine own mysterious sentence, "Ye have done it unto Me." Can it be, O gracious Master, Thou dost deign for alms to sue, Saying by Thy poor and needy, "Give as I have given you"

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Lord of Glory, who hast bought us with Thy lifeblood as the price, Never grudging for the lost ones that tremendous sacrifice; Give us faith, to trust Thee boldly; hope, to stay our souls on Thee; But O, best of all Thy graces, give us Thine own charity.

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 c1 v3 v4 c2 b1 c3 c4

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O come behold the works of God the nations at His feet. He breaks the bow and bends the spear and tells the wars to cease.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O Mighty One of Israel you are on our side. We walk by faith in God who burns the chariots with fire

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Lord of Hosts, You're with us with us in the fire, with us as a shelter, with us in the storm. You will lead us through the fiercest battle, oh where else would we go, but with the Lord of Hosts.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O God of Jacob, fierce and great, You lift Your voice to speak. The earth it bows and all the mountains move into the sea

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: O Lord You know the hearts of men and still you let them live. O God, who makes the mountains melt come wrestle us and win. O God who makes the mountains melt come wrestle us and win.

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: Lord of Hosts, You're with us with us in the fire, with us as a shelter, with us in the storm. You will lead us through the fiercest battle. Oh where else would we go, but with the Lord of Hosts.

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: Though oceans roar, You are the Lord of all, the one who calms the wind and waves and makes my heart be still. Though the earth gives way, the mountains move into the sea, the nations rage, I know my God is in control. Though oceans roar, You are the Lord of all, the one who calms the wind and waves and makes my heart be still. Though the earth gives way, the mountains move into the sea, the nations rage, I know my God is in control.

verse.name: c3
verse.lines: Lord of Hosts, You're with us with us in the fire, with us as a shelter, with us in the storm. You will lead us through the fiercest battle. Oh where else would we go, but with the Lord of Hosts.

verse.name: c4
verse.lines: You are with us with us in the fire, with us as a shelter, with us in the storm. You will lead us through the fiercest battle. Oh where else could we go, but with the Lord of Hosts.

titles.title: Lord of Life, All Praise Excelling

authors.author: Prichard, Rowland H. (1811-1887), Moore, Clement Clarke (1779-1863)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord of life, all praise excelling, Thou, in glory unconfined, Deignst to make Thy humble dwelling With the poor of humble mind. As Thy love, through all creation, Beams like Thy diffusive light; So the high and humble station Both are equal in Thy sight.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Thus Thy care, for all providing, Warmed Thy faithful prophet's tongue; Who, the lot of all deciding, To Thy chosen Israel sung. When Thy harvest yields Thee pleasure, Thou the golden sheaf shalt bind; To the poor belongs the treasure Of the scattered ears behind.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Still we read Thy Word declaring Mercy, Lord, Thine own decree; Mercy ev'ry sorrow sharing, Warms the heart resembling Thee. Still the orphan and the stranger, Still the widow owns Thy care; Screened by Thee in ev'ry danger, Heard by Thee in ev'ry prayer.

properties.verseOrder: v1 c1 v2 b2 b3 b5

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: All of my steps are Ordered by You You give every breath I take Only a kind God Gives power to choose So it is my privilege to say

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: You are the Lord You're the Lord of my life You are the Lord You're the Lord of my life Jesus Christ

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Though I may stumble I will not fall For I am upheld by Your hand Even in trial I'll count it as joy To say it again and again

verse.name: b2
verse.lines: // Every knee will bow Every tongue confess But it's my joy to do it now, Lord Jesus Every eye will see You in Your glory But I get to seek You now, Lord Jesus //

verse.name: b3
verse.lines: There will be a day Tears will be no more The angels and saints Will worship and adore I'll enter heaven's gates Forever sing Your name But I get to sing it now, Lord Jesus Jesus Yes, I get to sing it now, Lord Jesus Jesus Yes, I get to sing it now

verse.name: b5
verse.lines: Come take your place Come take your place Come take your place King Jesus

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: All my heartfelt dreams I put aide

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: To see you spirit move with power in my life

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: Jesus Lord of all eternity

verse.name: v7
verse.lines: Your children rise in faith

verse.name: v8
verse.lines: All the earth displays your glory

verse.name: v9
verse.lines: and each word you speak

verse.name: v10
verse.lines: Brings life to all who hear

verse.name: v11
verse.lines: Chorus:

verse.name: v12
verse.lines: Lord of all

verse.name: v13
verse.lines: All creation sings your praises

verse.name: v14
verse.lines: In heaven and earth

verse.lines: Lord we started hearts open wide

verse.name: v16

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord prepare me to be a sanctuary pure and holy tried and true With thanksgiving I'll be a living sanctuary for You

titles.title: Lord you are so precious to me

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord You are so precious to me Lord You are so precious to me And I love You, Yes I love You Because You first loved me.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Lord, You are so gracious to me; Lord, You are so gracious to me. And I love You, yes I love You, because You first loved me.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Seigneur tu est si precious pour moi Seigneur tu est si precious pour moi Et je t'aime, oui je t'aime Car tu m'a tant aimé

titles.title: Lord, Dismiss Us With Thy Blessing

authors.author: Smart, Henry Thomas (1813-1879), Fawcett, John (1740-1817), Thring, Godfrey (1823-1903)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, dismiss us with Thy blessing; Fill our hearts with joy and peace; Let us each Thy love possessing, Triumph in redeeming grace. O refresh us, O refresh us, Trav'ling through this wilderness.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Thanks we give and adoration For Thy Gospel's joyful sound; May the fruits of Thy salvation In our hearts and lives abound. Ever faithful, ever faithful, To the truth may we be found.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: So that when Thy love shall call us, Savior, from the world away, Fear of death shall not appall us, Glad Thy summons to obey. May we ever, may we ever, Reign with Thee in endless day.

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, enthroned in heav'nly splendor, First begotten from the dead, You alone, our strong Defender, Now lift up Your people's head. Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia! Jesus, true and living Bread! Jesus, true and living Bread!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Here our humblest homage pay we, Here in loving reference bow; Here for faith's discernment pray we, Lest we fail to know You now. Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia! Thou art here, we ask not how. Thou art here, we ask not how.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Though the lowliest form doth veil Thee As of old in Bethlehem, Here as there Thine angels hail Thee, Branch and Flow'r of Jesse's stem. Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia! We in worship join with them. We in worship join with them.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Paschal Lamb, Your offering finished Once for all when You were slain, In its fullness undiminished Shall forevermore remain. Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia! Cleansing souls from every stain. Cleansing souls from every stain.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Great High Priest of our profession, Through the veil Thou wentest in, By Thy mighty intercession, Grace and peace for us to win. Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia! Jesus, true and living Bread! Jesus, true and living Bread!

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: Life imparting heavenly Manna, Smitten Rock with streaming side, Heaven and earth with loud hosanna Worship You, the Lamb Who died. Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia! Risen, Ascended, Glorified!

titles.title: Lord, I Lift Your Name On High

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, I lift Your name on high. Lord, I love to sing Your praises. I'm so glad You're in my life. I'm so glad You came to save us.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: You came from heaven to earth To show the way; From the earth to the cross, my debt to pay. From the cross to the grave, From the grave to the sky. Lord I lift Your name on high.

titles.title: Lord, Keep Us Steadfast in Thy Word

authors.author: from Klug's Geistliche Lieder auffs new gebessert, Wittenberg, 1543, Luther, Martin (1483-1546), Winkworth, Catherine (1827-1878)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, keep us steadfast in Thy Word; Curb those who fain by craft and sword Would wrest the kingdom from Thy Son And set at naught all He hath done.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Lord Jesus Christ, Thy pow'r make known, For Thou art Lord of lords alone; Defend Thy Christendom that we May evermore sing praise to Thee.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O Comforter of priceless worth, Send peace and unity on earth. Support us in our final strife And lead us out of death to life.

titles.title: Lord, Lord, Lord You've surely been good to me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Lord, Lord, Lord You've surely been good to me; You have done what this world could not do.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: You saved my soul when I was lost You've surely been good to me; You have done what this world could not do.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: You filled me with the Holy Ghost, You've surely been good to me; You have done what this world could not do.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: You healed my body when I was sick, You've surely been good to me; You have done what this world could not do.

titles.title: Lord, Thee I Love with All My Heart

authors.author: from Strassburg, Schalling, Martin (1532-1608), Winkworth, Catherine (1827-1878)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, Thee I love with all my heart; I pray Thee, ne'er from me depart; With tender mercy cheer me. Earth has no pleasure I would share, Yea, Heav'n itself were void and bare If Thou, Lord, wert not near me. And should my heart for sorrow break, My trust in Thee can nothing shake. Thou art the portion I have sought; Thy precious blood my soul has bought. Lord Jesus Christ, My God and Lord, my God and Lord, Forsake me not! I trust Thy Word.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Yea, Lord, 'twas Thy rich bounty gave My body, soul, and all I have In this poor life of labor. Lord, grant that I in every place May glorify Thy lavish grace And serve and help my neighbor. Let no false doctrine me beguile, Let Satan not my soul defile. Give strength and patience unto me To bear my cross and follow Thee. Lord Jesus Christ, My God and Lord, my God and Lord, In death Thy comfort still afford.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Lord, let at last Thine angels come, To Abr'am's bosom bear me home, That I may die unfearing; And in its narrow chamber keep My body safe in peaceful sleep Until Thy reappearing. And then from death awaken me, That these mine eyes with joy may see, O Son of God, Thy glorious face, My Savior and my fount of grace. Lord Jesus Christ, My prayer attend, my prayer attend, And I will praise Thee without end!

titles.title: Lord, Who at Cana's Wedding Feast

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, who at Cana's wedding feast Didst as a Guest appear, Thou dearer far than earthly guest, Vouchsafe Thy presence here. For holy Thou indeed dost prove The marriage vow to be, Proclaiming it a type of love Between the Church and Thee.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: The holiest vow that man can make, The golden thread in life, The bond that none may dare to break, That bindeth man and wife, Which, blest by Thee, whate'er betide, No evil shall destroy, Through careworn days each care divides And doubles every joy.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: On those who at Thine altar kneel, O Lord, Thy blessing pour, That each may wake the other's zeal To love Thee more and more. Oh, grant them here in peace to live, In purity and love, And, this world leaving, to receive A crown of life above.

titles.title: Lord, You are more Precious than Silver

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, You are more precious than silver. Lord, You are more costly than gold. Lord, You are more beautiful than diamonds. Nothing that I desire compares with you.

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: Nothing that I desire compares with you.

titles.title: Lord, You've Set Your Throne Between the Cherubim

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: // Lord, You've set your throne between the cherubim, cherubim // And unto this heart of mine you are Light, O Lord Word, O Lord / Life, O Lord / Strength, O Lord The glory of your brightness is a path to me A path to me, the Way to me

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: You've spread your tent above me, O Lord Keep me secure, O my King By night, by day, I'll worship You, my Lord By night, by day, O Lord on high!

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Lord, here I am Reliant on Your mercy every day Lord, here I stand My heart wide open here for You to stay

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Guide my thoughts, my soul and everything I say Guard my heart and how I feel Let me hear Your words of love for me each day Then show me how to give Your love away

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: Lord, here I am Reliant on Your mercy every day Lord, here I stand My heart wide open here for You to stay

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Guide my thoughts, my soul and everything I say Guard my heart and how I feel Let me hear Your words of love for me each day Then show me how to give Your love away Then show me how to give Your love away

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, let Your glory fall as on that ancient day. Songs of enduring love, and then Your glory came. And as a sign to You that we would love the same, Our hearts will sing that song; God, let Your glory come.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: You are good, You are good, and Your love endures. You are good, You are good, and Your love endures. You are good, You are good, and Your love endures today.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Voices in unison giving You thanks and praise, Joined by the instruments and then Your glory came. Your presence like a cloud upon that ancient day. The priests were overwhelmed because Your glory came.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: A sacrifice was made, and then Your fire came. They knelt upon the ground, and with one voice they praised.

titles.title: Lord, the light of Your love is shining

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Lord, the light of Your love is shining, In the midst of the darkness, shining; Jesus, Light of the world, shine upon us, Set us free by the truth You now bring us, Shine on me, shine on me.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Shine, Jesus, shine, Fill this land with the Father's glory; Blaze, Spirit, blaze, Set our hearts on fire. Flow, river, flow, Flood the nations with grace and mercy; Send forth Your word, Lord, and let there be light.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Lord, I come to Your awesome presence, From the shadows into Your radiance; By the blood I may enter Your brightness, Search me, try me, consume all my darkness. Shine on me, shine on me.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: As we gaze on Your kingly brightness So our faces display Your likeness. Ever changing from glory to glory, Mirrored here may our lives tell Your story. Shine on me, shine on me.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Father You're the author of creation You're the joy of every nation There is none like You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Jesus You display the Father's glory You're the centre of the story There is none like You

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: So I fall down at Your feet Lost in wonder, worshipping Praises to the most high king I give you all of my affection Lord You're my everything Jesus You're my everything Take all the world just give me Jesus

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Messiah You're the stillness in the wrestling You're the answer to my questions I'm in awe of You

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Saviour You gave up your life to save us Day by day you recreate us I'm in awe of You

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: If my heart is overwhelmed and I cannot hear Your voice I'll hold on to what is true though I cannot see If the storms of life they come and the road ahead gets steep I will lift these hands in faith, I will believe

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: I remind myself of all that You've done And the life I have because of Your Son

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Love came down and rescued me Love came down and set me free Now I am Yours, I am forever Yours

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Mountain high or valley low

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: I sing out, remind my soul I am Yours, I am forever Yours

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: When my heart is filled with hope, when every promise comes my way When I feel Your hands of grace rest upon me Staying desperate for You God, staying humbled at Your feet I will lift these and praise, I will believe

verse.name: v7
verse.lines: I am Yours, I am Yours All my days I am Yours

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Love divine all loves excelling, joy of heaven to earth come down Fix in us Thy humble dwelling, all Thy faithful mercies crown Jesus Thou art all compassion, pure unbounded love Thou art Visit us with Thy salvation, enter every trembling heart

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Breathe O breathe Thy loving Spirit into every trembling breast Let us all in thee inherit, let us find thy promised rest Take away the love of sinning, Alpha and Omega be End of faith as it's beginning, set our hearts at liberty

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Come Almighty to deliver, let us all Thy grace receive Suddenly return and never, never more Thy temples leave Thee we would be always blessing, serve Thee as Thy hosts above Pray and praise Thee without ceasing, glory in Thy perfect love

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Finish then Thy new creation, pure and spotless let us be Let us see our whole salvation, perfectly restored in Thee Changed from glory into glory, till in heaven we take our place Till we cast our crowns before Thee, lost in wonder, love, and praise

properties.verseOrder: v2 c1 c2 v3 v4 v5 v7 v8

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Verse 1: We found love that never runs dry From the depths to the sky Eyes fixed on the One who knows no end You stand strong for all of time In the joy, in the trial You are the Beginning and the End

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Prechorus: Your love goes on Your love goes on

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: Chorus: Ever our heart will seek Jesus in everything From sky to ocean deep Your love goes on Through every rise and fall We are forever Yours One thing we know is sure Your love goes on and on and on

verse.lines: same as Intro

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Verse 2: From dawn break into the night You're here with us, You're on our side Your arms are forever open wide You stand strong for all of time In the joy, in the trial You are the Beginning and the End

titles.title: My Faith Looks Up To Thee

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: My faith looks up to Thee, Thou Lamb of Calvary, Savior divine! Now hear me while I pray, Take all my guilt away, O let me from this day Be wholly Thine!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: May Thy rich grace impart Strength to my fainting heart, My zeal inspire; As Thou hast died for me, O may my love to Thee Pure, warm, and changeless be, A living fire!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: While life's dark maze I tread, And griefs around me spread, Be Thou my Guide; Bid darkness turn to day, Wipe sorrow's tears away, Nor let me ever stray From Thee aside.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: When ends life's transient dream, When death's cold, sullen stream Shall o'er me roll; Blest Savior, then, in love, Fear and distrust remove; O bear me safe above, A ransomed soul!

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Unclean and battered, torn by sin, By things I do, my thoughts within, I lie there bloodied on life's road with death and sin my only load.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Across that road the world passed by turning a deaf ear to my cry, No help to give, they could not save and so they left me for my grave.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: And, what of me, when I saw need? Did I my Savior's bidding heed? Too often on the other side I've walked away because of pride.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Sin bleeds from me and stops my breath, in Adam all I know is death; My works are rags, my offerings vain, From dust I came in dust remain.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: But in my need my Savior died, Not passing on the other side. Rebreathed His Spirit in my dust, bound up my wounds, declared me just.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: Now safe within His Church I'm free; Blood, Water, Spirit plead for me, The Ark of God, the Inn of Grace Where I behold my Father's face.

titles.title: Not Worthy, Lord, to Gather Up the Crumbs

authors.author: Monk, William Henry (1823-1889), Bickersteth, Edward Henry Jr. (1825-1906)

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Not worthy, Lord, to gather up the crumbs With trembling hand that from Thy table fall, A weary, heavy laden sinner comes To plead Thy promise and obey Thy call.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: I am not worthy to be thought Thy child, Nor sit the last and lowest at Thy board; Too long a wanderer and too oft beguiled; I only ask one reconciling word.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: One word from Thee, my Lord, one smile, one look, And I could face the cold, rough world again; And with that treasure in my heart could brook The wrath of devils and the scorn of men.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: And is not mercy Thy prerogative\Free mercy, boundless, fathomless, divine? Me, Lord, the chief of sinners, me forgive, And Thine the greater glory, only Thine.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: I hear Thy voice; Thou bid'st me come and rest; I come, I kneel, I clasp Thy piercèd feet; Thou bid'st me take my place, a welcome guest Among Thy saints, and of Thy banquet eat.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: My praise can only breathe itself in prayer, My prayer can only lose itself in Thee; Dwell Thou forever in my heart, and there, Lord, let me sup with Thee; sup Thou with me.

titles.title: Now Praise We Christ, the Holy One

authors.author: Latin, from Erfurt Enchiridion, Sedulius, Coelius (5th Century), Luther, Martin (1483-1546), Massie, Richard (1800-1887)

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Now praise we Christ, the Holy One, The spotless virgin Mary's Son, Far as the blesséd sun doth shine E'en to the world's remote confine

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: He, who Himself all things did make, A servant's form vouchsafed to take, That He as man mankind might win, And save His creatures from their sin.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: The grace of God, th'Almighty Lord, On the chaste mother was outpoured a virgin pure and undefiled In wondrous wise conceived a child.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: The holy maid became th'abode And temple of the living God; And she, who knew not man, was blest With God's own Word made manifest.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: The noble mother bare a Son, For so did Gabriel's promise run, Whom John confessed and leapt with joy, Ere yet the mother knew her boy.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: In a rude manger, stretched on hay, In poverty content He lay; With milk was fed the Lord of all, Who feeds the ravens when they call.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines: Th' angelic choir rejoice, and raise Their voice to God in songs of praise; To humble shepherds is proclaimed The Shepherd who the world hath framed.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines: Honor to Thee, O Christ, be paid, Pure offspring of a holy maid, With Father and with Holy Ghost, Till time in time's abyss be lost.

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Now rest beneath night's shadow The woodland, field, and meadow, The world in slumber lies; But Thou, my heart, awake thee, To prayer and song betake thee; Let praise to thy Creator rise.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: The radiant sun hath vanished, His golden rays are banished By night, the foe of day; But Christ, the Sun of gladness, Dispelling all my sadness, Within my heart holds constant sway.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: The rule of day is over And shining jewels cover The heaven's boundless blue. Thus I shall shine in heaven, Where crowns of gold are given To all who faithful prove and true.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: To rest my body hasteth, Aside its garments casteth, Types of mortality; These I put off and ponder How Christ will give me yonder A robe of glorious majesty.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Lord Jesus, who dost love me, Oh, spread Thy wings above me And shield me from alarm! Though evil would assail me, Thy mercy will not fail me: I rest in Thy protecting arm.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: My loved ones, rest securely, For God this night will surely From peril guard your heads. Sweet slumbers may He send you And bid His hosts attend you And through the night watch o'er your beds.

titles.title: Now Thank We All Our God

authors.author: Crüger, Johann (1598-1662), Rinkart, Martin (1586-1649), Winkworth, Catherine (1827-1878)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Now thank we all our God, with heart and hands and voices, Who wondrous things has done, in Whom this world rejoices; Who from our mothers' arms has blessed us on our way With countless gifts of love, and still is ours today.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O may this bounteous God through all our life be near us, With ever joyful hearts and blessed peace to cheer us; And keep us in His grace, and guide us when perplexed; And free us from all ills, in this world and the next!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: All praise and thanks to God the Father now be given; The Son and Him Who reigns with Them in highest Heaven; The one eternal God, Whom earth and Heav'n adore; For thus it was, is now, and shall be evermore.

verse.name: v1

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Now the light has gone away; Father, listen while I pray, Asking Thee to watch and keep And to send me quiet sleep.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Jesus, Savior, wash away All that has been wrong today; Help me every day to be Good and gentle, more like Thee.

verse.name: v3

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Now my evening praise I give; Thou didst die that I might live. All my blessings come from Thee; Oh, how good Thou art to me!

verse.name: v5

titles.title: O Be Glad All Nations on Earth

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O be glad, all nations on Earth, Come let Jesus' Name be praised; He is crowned, the King of glory, At God's right hand He is raised. Angels bowing down before Him, Singing with the heav'nly throng; Elders casting crowns before Him, Singing an eternal song.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Great and marvelous are Your works, Just and true are all Your ways; All the nations bow in worship, King of kings, Your Name they praise. Angels bowing down before Him, Singing with the heav'nly throng; Elders casting crowns before Him, Singing an eternal song.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: When shall Heav'n and Earth together, Walk before the Lamb, its Light? When shall all the saints be gathered, and that Day shall end the night? Angels bowing down before Him, Singing with the heav'nly throng; Elders casting crowns before Him, Singing an eternal song.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Lo, that day shall come with glory, When Christ comes with trumpet sound; Then the saints will cease their groaning, Never more by death's chains bound. Let us all bow down before Him, Sing, O sing th'eternal song; Work in hope until we meet Him, And we join the heav'nly throng.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O chief of cities, Bethlehem, Of David's crown the fairest gem, But more to us than David's name, In you, as man, the Savior came.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Beyond the sun in splendor bright, Above you stands a wondrous light Proclaiming from the conscious skies That here, in flesh, the Godhead lies.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: The wise men, seeing Him so fair, Bow low before Him, and with prayer Their treasured eastern gifts unfold Of incense, myrrh, and royal gold.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: The golden tribute owns Him King, But frankincense to God they bring, And last, prophetic sign, with myrrh, They shadow forth His sepulcher.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: O Jesus, whom the Gentiles see, With Father, Spirit, One in Three: To You, O God, be glory giv'n By saints on earth and saints in Heav'n.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: A7sus4 D G A O Church arise and put your armour on Hear the call of Christ our captain A7sus4 D G A For now the weak can say that they are strong With the strength that God has given With shield of faith and belt of truth We'll stand against the devil's lies An army bold whose battle cry is love Reaching out to those in darkness

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Our call to war, to love the captive soul But to rage against the captor And with the sword that makes the wounded whole We will fight with faith and valourWhen faced with trials on every side We know the outcome is secure And Christ will have the prize for which He died An inheritance of nations

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Come, see the cross where love and mercy meet As the Son of God is stricken And see His foes lie crushed beneath His feet For the Conqueror has risen And as the stone is rolled away And Christ emerges from the grave This victory march continues 'til the day Every eye and heart shall see Him

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: So Spirit, come put strength in every stride Give grace for every hurdle That we may run with faith to win the prize Of a servant good and faithful As saints of old still line the way Retelling triumphs of His grace We hear their call and hunger for the day When with Christ we stand in glory

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: A D A Em A D G D

titles.title: O Come Let Us Adore Him

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O come, let us adore Him, O come, let us adore Him, O come, let us adore Him, Christ the Lord.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: For You alone are worthy, for You alone are worthy; For You alone are worthy, Christ the Lord.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: We give You all the glory, we give You all the glory; We give You all the glory, Christ the Lord.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: We'll praise Your name for ever, we'll praise Your name for ever; We'll praise Your name for ever, Christ the Lord.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O come, O come, Emmanuel, And ransom captive Israel, That mourns in lonely exile here Until the Son of God appear. Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel shall come to thee, O Israel.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O come, Thou Wisdom from on high, Who orderest all things mightily; To us the path of knowledge show, And teach us in her ways to go. Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel shall come to thee, O Israel.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O come, Thou Rod of Jesse, free Thine own from Satan's tyranny; From depths of hell Thy people save, And give them vict'ry ov'r the grave. Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel shall come to thee, O Israel.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: O come, Thou Dayspring, come and cheer Our spirits by Thine advent here; Disperse the gloomy clouds of night, And death's dark shadows put to flight. Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel shall come to thee, O Israel.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: O come, Thou Key of David, come, And open wide our heav'nly home; Make safe the way that leads on high, And close the path to misery. Rejoice! Rejoice! Emmanuel shall come to thee, O Israel.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: VERSE: 1 Are you hurting and broken within Overwhelmed by the weight of your sin Jesus is calling Have you come to the end of yourself Do you thirst for a drink from the well Jesus is calling

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: CHORUS: O come to the altar The fathers arms are open wide Forgiveness was bought with The precious blood of Jesus Christ

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: VERSE: 2 Leave behind your regrets and mistakes Come today theres no reason to wait Jesus is calling Bring your sorrows and trade them for joy From the ashes a new life is born Jesus is calling

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: O what a savior isn't he wonderful Sing alleluia Christ is risen Bow down before him, for he is Lord of all Sing alleluia Christ is risen

titles.title: O Day of Rest And Gladness

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O day of rest and gladness, o day of joy and light, O balm of care and sadness, most beautiful, most bright: On thee, the high and lowly, through ages joined in tune, Sing holy, holy, holy, to the great God Triune.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: On thee, at the creation, the light first had its birth; On thee, for our salvation, Christ rose from depths of earth; On thee, our Lord, victorious, the Spirit sent from heaven, And thus on thee, most glorious, a triple light was given.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Thou art a port, protected from storms that round us rise; A garden, intersected with streams of paradise; Thou art a cooling fountain in life's dry, dreary sand; From thee, like Pisgah's mountain, we view our promised land.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Thou art a holy ladder, where angels go and come; Each Sunday finds us gladder, nearer to heaven, our home; A day of sweet refection, thou art a day of love, A day of resurrection from earth to things above.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Today on weary nations the heavenly manna falls; To holy convocations the silver trumpet calls, Where Gospel light is glowing with pure and radiant beams, And living water flowing, with soul refreshing streams.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: New graces ever gaining from this our day of rest, We reach the rest remaining to spirits of the blessed. To Holy Ghost be praises, to Father, and to Son; The church her voice upraises to Thee, blessed Three in One.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Father, all creating, Whose wisdom, love, and pow'r First bound two lives together In Eden's primal hour, Today to these Thy children Thy earliest gifts renew: A home by Thee made happy, A love by Thee kept true.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O Savior, Guest most bounteous Of old in Galilee, Vouchsafe today Thy presence With these who call on Thee; Their store of earthly gladness Transform to heav'nly wine, And teach them, in the tasting To know the gift is Thine.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O Spirit of the Father, Breathe on them from above, So mighty in Thy pureness, So tender in Thy love; That, guarded by Thy presence, From sin and strife kept free, Their lives may own Thy guidance, Their hearts be rul'd by Thee.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Except Thou build it, Father, The house is built in vain; Except Thou, Savior, bless it, The joy will turn to pain; But naught can break the union Of hearts in Thee made one, And love Thy Spirit hallow'd Is endless love begun.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O for a thousand tongues to sing My great Redeemer's praise, The glories of my God and King, The triumphs of His grace!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: My gracious Master and my God, Assist me to proclaim, To spread through all the earth abroad The honors of Thy name.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Jesus! the name that charms our fears, That bids our sorrows cease; 'Tis music in the sinner's ears, 'Tis life, and health, and peace.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: He breaks the pow'r of canceled sin, He sets the prisoner free; His blood can make the foulest clean, His blood availed for me.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: He speaks, and, listening to His voice, New life the dead receive, The mournful, broken hearts rejoice, The humble poor believe.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O God of love, I come to You again, Knowing I'll find mercy. I can't explain all the things I see, But I'll trust in You. In every moment You are there, Watching over You hear my prayer. You go before me, You're behind me, Nothing's hidden from You.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: How good it is to be loved by You, How good it is.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O God of strength, Your hand is on my life, Bringing peace to me. You know my frame, You know how I am made, You planned all my days. Hand of mercy, hand of love, Giving power to overcome. If all beneath me falls away, I know that You are God.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Who can stand against us? In my weakness You are strong. Your word is everlasting, I will praise You, faithful One.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O heavens, O earth Our God is worthy of our praise We were all sinful at heart We owe all to wondrous grace Through the Savior Who came down from on high We received grace

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O heavens, O earth We are all saved by his true grace We were all sinful at heart We were starved, craving love Through his love that Came to us from above We reached God

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O heavens, O earth Our God's pow'r 's enough for anything We were all sinful at heart We were mired deep in sin Through his pardon That came from heav'n above Grace cleansed us

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: O heavens, O earth Our way leads to eternity

properties.verseOrder: v1 c1 v2 c2 v3 c3

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O holy night, the stars are brightly shining; It is the night of the dear Savior's birth. Long lay the world in sin and error pining, Till he appeared and the soul felt its worth. A thrill of hope, the weary soul rejoices, For yonder breaks a new and glorious morn.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Fall on your knees, Oh, hear the angel voices! O night divine, O night . when Christ was born! O night, O holy night, O night divine!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Led by the light of faith serenely beaming, With glowing hearts by His cradle we stand. O'er the world a star is sweetly gleaming, Now come the wisemen from out of the Orient land.

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: The King of kings lay thus lowly manger; In all our trials born to be our friends. He knows our need, our weakness is no stranger, Beho-ld your King! Before - him lowly bend! Behold your King! Before him - lowly bend!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Truly He taught us to love one another, His law is love and His gospel is peace. Chains he shall break, for the slave is our brother. And in his name all oppression shall cease. Sweet hymns of joy in grateful chorus raise we, With all our hearts we praise His holy name. Christ is the Lord! Then ever, ever praise we, His power and glory ever more proclaim!

verse.name: c3
verse.lines: Fall on your knees, Oh, hear the angel voices! O night divine, O night . when Christ was born! O night, O holy night, O night divine! O night, O holy night, O night divine!

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O holy river Flow into my garden, flow Soaking, soaking this thirsty ground Flow, with blessings From the springs of wisdom To the shores of righteousness Flow with blessings From the springs of wisdom To the shores of righteousness Flow with bountiful life

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O holy river Flow into my garden, flow Leaf by leaf, restoring life Flow, with blessings From the springs of wisdom To the shores of righteousness Flow with blessings From the springs of wisdom To the shores of righteousness Flow with bountiful life

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O holy river Flow into my garden, flow Cleansing, cleansing each hidden place Flow with blessings From the springs of wisdom To the shores of righteousness Flow with blessings From the springs of wisdom To the shores of righteousness Flow with bountiful life O holy river

authors.author: Nicolai, Phillipp (1556-1608), Schirmer, Michael (1606-1673), Winkworth, Catherine (1827-1878)

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Holy Spirit, enter in, And in our hearts Thy work begin Thy Temple deign to make us; Sun of the soul, Thou Light divine, Around and in us brightly shine, To joy and gladness wake us. That we to Thee Truly living, To Thee giving Prayer unceasing May in love be still increasing.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Give to Thy Word impressive pow'r That in our hearts, from this good hour, As fire it may be glowing; That we confess the Father, Son, And Thee, the Spirit, Three in One, Thy glory ever showing. Stay Thou, guide now Our souls ever that they never May forsake Thee. But by faith their refuge make Thee.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Thou fountain whence all wisdom flows Which God on pious hearts bestows, Grant us Thy consolation. That in our pure faith's unity We faithful witnesses may be Of grace that brings salvation. Hear us, cheer us, By Thy teaching; let our preaching, And our labor Praise Thee, Lord, and serve our neighbor.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Left to ourselves, we shall but stray; O lead us on the narrow way, With wisest counsel guide us; And give us steadfastness, that we May ever faithful prove to Thee, Whatever woes betide us; Lord now Heal Thou All hearts broken, And betoken Thou art near us, Whom we trust to light and cheer us.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Thy heav'nly strength sustain our heart That we may act the valiant part With Thee as our Reliance; Be Thou our Refuge and our Shield That we may never quit the field, But stand in bold defiance. Descend, defend From all errors And earth's terrors Thy salvation Be our constant consolation.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: O mighty Rock, O Source of life, Let Thy dear Word 'mid doubt and strife Be so within us burning, That we be faithful unto death, In Thy pure love and holy faith, From Thee true wisdom learning! Thy grace And peace On us shower; By Thy power Christ confessing, Let us win our Savior's blessing.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines: O gentle Dew, from Heav'n now fall With pow'r upon the hearts of all, Thy tender love instilling, That heart to heart more closely bound, Fruitful in kindly deeds be found, The law of love fulfilling; The Lord, Discord Shall not grieve Thee; We recieve Thee; Where Thou livest. Peace, and love, and joy Thou givest.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines: Grant that our days, while life shall last, In purest holiness be passed, Be Thou our Strength forever; Grant that our hearts henceforth be free From sinful lust and vanity Which us from Thee must sever. Keep Thou pure Now From offenses Heart and senses. Blessed Spirit! Let us heavenly life inherit.

authors.author: Hermann, Nikolaus (1500-1561), Behm, Martin (1557-1622), Schuette, Conrad Herman Louis (1843-1926)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Holy, Blessed Trinity, Divine, Essential Unity, God Father, Son, and Holy Ghost, Be Thou this day my Guide and Host.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: My soul and body keep from harm, O'er all I have extend Thine arm, That Satan may not cause distress Nor bring me shame or wretchedness.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: The Father's might shield me this day, The Son's pure wisdom cheer my way, The Holy Spirit's light divine Illume my heart's benighted shrine.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: My Maker, strengthen Thou my heart, O my Redeemer, help impart, Blest Comforter, keep at my side That faith and love in me abide.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Lord, bless and keep Thou me as Thine; Lord, make Thy face upon me shine; Lord, lift Thy countenance on me And give me peace\sweet peace, from Thee.

titles.title: O How He Loves You and Me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Oh, how He loves you and me Oh, how He loves you and me He gave his life What more could He give Oh, how He loves you Oh, how He loves me Oh, how He loves you and me

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Jesus to Calvary did go, His love for sinners to show. What He did there brought hope from despair. Oh, how He loves you; Oh, how He loves me; Oh, how He loves you and me.

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: Oh, how He loves you and me, Oh how He loves you and me. He gave his life, what more could He give? Oh, how He loves you; Oh, how He loves me; Oh, how He loves you and me.

properties.verseOrder: v1 c1 v2 c2 v3 c3 v4 c4

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: There is a name I love to hear. I love to sing it's worth. It sounds like music in my ear, the sweetest name on earth.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: Oh, How I love Jesus, Oh how I love Jesus, Oh How I love Jesus Because He first loved me.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: It tells me of a Saviour's love who died to set me free. It tells me of His precious blood, the sinners perfect plea.

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: Oh how I love Jesus oh how I love Jesus oh how I love Jesus Because He first loved me

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: It tells me what my Father hath in store for every day, And tho' I tread a darksome path, yields sunshine all the way.

verse.name: c3
verse.lines: Oh to me he is so wonderful to me he is so wonderful to me he is so wonderful Because he first loved me

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: It tells of One whose loving heart can feel my deepest woe, Who in each sorrow bears a part that none can bear below.

verse.name: c4
verse.lines: Oh how I love Jesus oh how I love Jesus oh how I love Jesus Because he first loved me

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O little town of Bethlehem, How still we see thee lie; Above thy deep and dreamless sleep, The silent stars go by. Yet in thy dark streets shineth The everlasting light; The hopes and fears of all the years Are met in thee tonight.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: For Christ is born of Mary, And gather'd all above, While mortals sleep, the angels keep Their watch of wond'ring love. O morning stars together Proclaim the holy birth And praises sing to God the King And peace to men on earth.

titles.title: O Lord Jesus come to me

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord Jesus come to me! Please come lead me in Your way. I put my life into Your hands My beloved Jesus Christ

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: // How I've longed to be with You, How I've longed to know Your peace. I cry out to You O Lord, Lead me now and evermore. //

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: I won't turn my heart away I won't seek another love You alone are my desire You who bore the cross for me

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: I have put my trust in You, I will always follow You Be the ruler of my heart, My beloved Jesus Christ

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord, my soul convicted stands Of breaking all Thy ten commands: And on me justly might'st Thou pour Thy wrath in one eternal show'r.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: But thanks to God, its loud alarms Have warn'd me of approaching harms; And now, O Lord, my wants I see, Lost and undone, I come to Thee.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: I know my fig leaf righteousness Can ne'er Thy broken law redress; Yet in the gospel plan I see, There's hope of pardon e'en for me.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: There, I behold with wonder, Lord! That Christ hath to Thy law restor'd Those honors on th'atoning day, Which guilty sinners took away.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Amazing wisdom, pow'r and love, Display'd to rebels from above! Do Thou, O Lord, my faith increase To love and trust Thy plan of grace.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: We will seek You first, Lord. You will hear our voices Early in the morning And late in the night. We will sing Your praises, Giving You the glory, Offering our lives to You, A holy sacrifice.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: May our praise arise as incense, O Lord, to You. May our worship be a fragrance, O Lord, to You.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord, we praise Thee, bless Thee, and adore Thee, In thanksgiving bow before Thee Thou with Thy body and Thy blood didst nourish Our weak souls that they may flourish: O Lord, have mercy! May Thy body, Lord, born of Mary, That our sins and sorrows did carry, And Thy blood for us plead In all trial, fear, and need: O Lord, have mercy!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Thy holy body into death was given, Life to win for us in heaven. No greater love than this to Thee could bind us; May this feast thereof remind us! O Lord, have mercy! Lord, Thy kindness did so constrain Thee That Thy blood should bless and sustain me. All our debt Thou hast paid; Peace with God once more is made: O Lord, have mercy.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: May God bestow on us His grace and favor To please Him with our behavior And live as brethren here in love and union Nor repent this blest Communion! O Lord, have mercy! Let not Thy good Spirit forsake us; Grant that heav'nly\minded He make us; Give Thy Church, Lord, to see Days of peace and unity: O Lord, have mercy!

titles.title: O Lord of Heav'n and Earth and Sea

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord of Heav'n and earth and sea, To Thee all praise and glory be; How shall we show our love to Thee, Who givest all?

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: The golden sunshine, vernal air, Sweet flow'rs and fruits, Thy love declare; Where harvests ripen, Thou art there, Who givest all.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: For peaceful homes and healthful days, For all the blessings earth displays, We owe Thee thankfulness and praise, Who givest all.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Thou didst not spare Thine only Son, But gav'st Him for a world undone, And freely, with that blessèd One, Thou givest all.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Thou giv'st the Spirit's blessèd dow'r, Spirit of life and love and pow'r, And dost His sev'nfold graces show'r Upon us all.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: For souls redeemed, for sins forgiv'n, For means of grace and hopes of Heav'n, Father, all praise to Thee be giv'n, Who givest all.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines: We lose what on ourselves we spend, We have as treasure without end Whatever, Lord, to Thee we lend, Who givest all.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines: To Thee, from Whom we all derive Our life, our gifts, our power to give: O may we ever with Thee live, Who givest all.

titles.title: O Lord, How Shall I Meet Thee

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8 v9 v10

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord, how shall I meet Thee, How welcome Thee aright? All nations long to see Thee, My Hope, my heart's Delight! O kindle, Lord, most holy, Thy lamp within my breast, To do in spirit lowly All that may please Thee best.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Thy Zion palms is strewing, And branches fresh and fair; My heart, its pow'rs renewing, An anthem shall prepare. My soul puts off her sadness Thy glories to proclaim; With all her strength and gladness She fain would serve Thy Name.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: What hast Thou left ungranted To give me glad relief? When soul and body panted In utmost depth of grief, In deepest degradation, Devoid of joy and peace, Then, Thou, my soul's Salvation, Didst come to bring release.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: I lay in fetters groaning, Thou com'st to set me free; I stood, my shame bemoaning, Thou com'st to honor me. A glory Thou dost give me, A treasure safe on high, That will not fail nor leave me As earthly riches fly.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Love caused Thine incarnation Love brought Thee down to me; Thy thirst for my salvation Procured my liberty. O love beyond all telling, That led Thee to embrace, In love all love excelling, Our lost and fallen race!

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: Rejoice, then, ye sad-hearted, Who sit in deepest gloom, Who mourn o'er joys departed, And tremble at your doom: Despair not, He is near you, Yea, standing at the door; He brings His pity near you, And bids you weep no more.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines: No care nor effort either Is needed day or night, How ye may draw Him hither In your own strength and might. He comes, He comes with gladness, Moved by His love alone, To calm your fear and sadness, To Him they well are known.

verse.name: v8
verse.lines: Sin's debt, that fearful burden, Let not your souls distress; Your guilt the Lord will pardon and cover with His grace. He comes, He comes procuring The peace of sin forgiv'n, To all God's sons securing Their part and lot in heav'n.

verse.name: v9
verse.lines: Why should the wicked move you? Heed not their craft and spite! Your Savior who doth love you, Will scatter all their might. He comes, a King most glorious, and all His earthly foes In vain His course victorious Endeavor to oppose.

verse.name: v10
verse.lines: He comes to judge the nations, A terror to His foes, A light of consolations And blessed hope to those Who love the Lord's appearing. O glorious Sun, now come, Send forth Thy beams so cheering, And guide is safely home!

titles.title: O Lord, I Am Not Worthy

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord, I am not worthy That Thou should'st come to me, But speak the words of comfort, My spirit healed shall be.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O Lord, Thou art all holy, The angels Thee adore; How, then, ought I sincerely My wrongs and sins deplore!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: But when Thou soon wilt enter My heart, my sinful heart, Then heal me, be my shelter, For Thou my Savior art.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: O Lord, how can I thank Thee For such a gift as this? A gift which truly filleth My soul with heav'nly bliss!

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: I praise Thee, I extol Thee, I love Thee O my Sire, Till once in joy and glory, In heav'n I Thee admire.

titles.title: O Lord, My God, I Thirst For You

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord, my God, I thirst for You, I long to see your face, Just as the hunted deer is stressed I falter in the race; My heart cries out, my tears run down, I am in deep distress, 'Where is your God?' men say to me, They taunt me and oppress.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Lord, when will I be helped by You, I struggle day and night? O hear my prayer, enable me to stand in your great might; I look back on those days gone by when, Lord, You were so near, when in your house with festive throng I praised your Name so dear.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: So why am I cast down, O Lord, and why should I feel low? You are my God, my Savior strong, Your praise from me shall flow; I think of all your works, O Lord, Your saving pow'r of old, So when beset and overwhelmed, I will your strength take hold.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Your loving\kindness fills my days, Your song at night I sing, And when my fears assail again to You I'll tightly cling; My hope is fixed on God, my Rock, His own He won't forget; Be still my soul, my face will shine And I will praise Him yet.

titles.title: O Lord, My Rock and My Redeemer

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer Greatest treasure of my longing soul My God, like You there is no other True delight is found in You alone Your grace, a well too deep to fathom Your love exceeds the heavens' reach Your truth, a fount of perfect wisdom My highest good and my unending need

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer Strong defender of my weary heart My sword to fight the cruel deceiver And my shield against his hateful darts My song when enemies surround me My hope when tides of sorrow rise My joy when trials are abounding Your faithfulness, my refuge in the night

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer Gracious Savior of my ruined life My guilt and cross laid on Your shoulders In my place You suffered bled and died You rose, the grave and death are conquered You rose, the grave and death are conquered You broke my bonds of sin and shame O Lord, my Rock and my Redeemer May all my days bring glory to Your Name May all my days bring glory to Your Name

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Oh Lord, you're beau-ti-ful Your face is all I seek And when your eyes are on this child Your grace abounds to me

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: I want to take your word and shine it all around But first help me just, to live it Lord And when I'm do-ing well Help me to never seek a crown For my reward is giving glory to You

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Oh Lord, please light the fire That once burned bright and clean Replace the lamp of my first love That burns with holy fear That burns with holy fear

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Oh Lord, you're beau-ti-ful Your face is all I seek And when your eyes are on this child Your grace abounds to me Your grace abounds to me

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Lord, Your tenderness Melting all my bitterness, O Lord, I receive Your love. O Lord, Your loveliness, Changing all my ugliness, O Lord, I receive Your love.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: O Lord, I receive Your love! O Lord, I receive Your love! O Lord, I receive Your love! O Lord, I receive Your love!

titles.title: O Love That Will Not Let Me Go

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Love that will not let me go, I rest my weary soul in thee; I give thee back the life I owe, That in thine ocean depths its flow May richer, fuller be.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O Light that follows all my way, I yield my flickering torch to thee; My heart restores its borrowed ray, That in thy sunshine's blaze its day May brighter, fairer be.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O Joy that seekest me through pain, I cannot close my heart to thee; I trace the rainbow through the rain, And feel the promise is not vain, That morn shall tearless be.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: O Cross that liftest up my head, I dare not ask to fly from thee; I lay in dust life's glory dead, And from the ground there blossoms red Life that shall endless be.

titles.title: O Love, How Deep, How Broad, How High

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O love, how deep, how broad, how high, How passing thought and fantasy, That God, the Son of God, should take Our mortal form for mortals' sake!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: He sent no angel to our race Of higher or of lower place, But wore the robe of human frame And He Himself, to this world came.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Nor willed He only to appear; His pleasure was to tarry here; And God and Man with man would be The space of thirty years and three.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: For us baptized, for us He bore His holy fast and hungered sore, For us temptations sharp He knew; For us the tempter overthrew.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: For us He prayed; for us He taught; For us His daily works He wrought; By words and signs and actions thus Still seeking not Himself, but us.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: For us to wicked men betrayed, Scourged, mocked, in crown of thorns arrayed, For us He bore the cross's death, For us at length gave up His breath.

verse.name: v7
v8
verse.lines: All honor, laud, and glory be, O Jesus, virgin-born to Thee! All glory, as is ever meet To Father and to Paraclete.

titles.title: O Praise Him (All This for a King)

properties.verseOrder: v1 p1 c1 v2 b1 p2 c2

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Turn your ear to heaven and hear the noise inside: The sound of angels' awe, the sound of angels' songs, All this for a King; we could join and sing, all to Christ the King.

verse.name: p1
verse.lines: How constant, how divine, this song of ours will rise. O, how constant, how divine, this love of ours will rise, will rise.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: O praise Him! O praise Him! He is Holy! He is Holy!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: Turn your gaze to heaven and raise a joyous noise: The sound of salvation come, the sound of rescued ones, All this for a king; angels join to sing, all for Christ our King.

verse.name: b1
verse.lines: Oh, la, la, la, la, la, la.

verse.name: p2
verse.lines: How infinite and sweet, this love so rescuing. O, how infinitely sweet, this great love that has redeemed. As one we sing:

verse.name: c2
verse.lines: Alleluia! Alleluia! He is Holy! He is Holy! Alleluia! Alleluia! He is Holy! He is Holy!

authors.author: Hassler, Hans Leo (1564-1612), Bernard of Clairvaux (1091-1153), Alexander, James Waddel (1804-1859), Bach, Johann Sebastian (1685-1750)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O sacred Head, now wounded, with grief and shame weighed down, Now scornfully surrounded with thorns, Thine only crown; O sacred Head, what glory, what bliss till now was Thine! Yet, though despised and gory, I joy to call Thee mine.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: What Thou, my Lord, hast suffered, was all for sinners' gain; Mine, mine was the transgression, but Thine the deadly pain. Lo, here I fall, my Savior! 'Tis I deserve Thy place; Look on me with Thy favor, vouchsafe to me Thy grace.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: Men mock and taunt and jeer Thee, Thou noble countenance, Though mighty worlds shall fear Thee and flee before Thy glance. How art thou pale with anguish, with sore abuse and scorn! How doth Thy visage languish that once was bright as morn!

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Now from Thy cheeks has vanished their color once so fair; From Thy red lips is banished the splendor that was there. Grim death, with cruel rigor, hath robbed Thee of Thy life; Thus Thou hast lost Thy vigor, Thy strength in this sad strife.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: My burden in Thy Passion, Lord, Thou hast borne for me, For it was my transgression which brought this woe on Thee. I cast me down before Thee, wrath were my rightful lot; Have mercy, I implore Thee; Redeemer, spurn me not!

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Sacred king O Holy King How can I honor You rightly Honor that's fit for Your name

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O Sacred Friend O Holy friend I don't take what You did lightly Friendship instead of disgrace

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: For it's the mystery of the universe You're the God of holiness Yet You welcome souls like me And with the blessing of your father's heart You discipline the ones you love There's kindness in Your majesty Jesus those who recognize your power Know just how wonderful You are When You draw near.

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: Live

titles.title: O That The Lord Would Guide My Ways

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O that the Lord would guide my ways To keep His statutes still! O that my God would grant me grace To know and do His will!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O send Thy Spirit down to write Thy law upon my heart! Nor let my tongue indulge deceit, Nor act the liar's part.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: From vanity turn off mine eyes; Let no corrupt design, Nor covetous desires arise Within this soul of mine.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: Order my footsteps by Thy Word, And make my heart sincere; Let sin have no dominion, Lord, But keep my conscience clear.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: Assist my soul, too apt to stray, A stricter watch to keep; And should I e'er forget Thy way, Restore Thy wand'ring sheep.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: Make me to walk in Thy commands, 'Tis a delightful road; Nor let my head, or heart, or hands, Offend against my God.

titles.title: O The Deep, Deep Love of Jesus

authors.author: Williams, Thomas J. (1869-1944), Francis, Samuel Trevor (1834-1925)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O the deep, deep love of Jesus, vast, unmeasured, boundless, free! Rolling as a mighty ocean in its fullness over me! Underneath me, all around me, is the current of Thy love Leading onward, leading homeward to Thy glorious rest above!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O the deep, deep love of Jesus, spread His praise from shore to shore! How He loveth, ever loveth, changeth never, nevermore! How He watches o'er His loved ones, died to call them all His own; How for them He intercedeth, watcheth o'er them from the throne!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O the deep, deep love of Jesus, love of every love the best! 'Tis an ocean full of blessing, 'tis a haven giving rest! O the deep, deep love of Jesus, 'tis a heav'n of heav'ns to me; And it lifts me up to glory, for it lifts me up to Thee!

authors.author: Latin, Ambrose of Milan (340-397), Neale, John Mason (1818-1866)

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O Trinity of blessèd light, O Unity of princely might, The fiery sun now goes his way; Shed Thou within our hearts a ray.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: To Thee our morning song of praise, To Thee our evening prayer we raise; O grant us with Thy saints on high To praise Thee through eternity.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: All laud to God the Father be, All praise, eternal Son, to Thee, All glory, as is ever meet, To God the holy Paraclete.

titles.title: O Wondrous Type, O Vision Fair

properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O wondrous type! O vision fair Of glory that the Church may share, Which Christ upon the mountain shows, where brighter than the sun He glows!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: From age to age the tale declare, How with the three disciples there, Where Moses and Elijah meet, The Lord holds converse high and sweet.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: The law and prophets there have place, Two chosen witnesses of grace; The Father's voice from out the cloud proclaims His only Son aloud.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: With shining face and bright array, Christ deigns to manifest today What glory shall be theirs above who joy in God with perfect love.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines: And faithful hearts are raised on high by this great vision's mystery; For which in joyful strains we raise the voice of prayer, the hymn of praise.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines: O Father, with th'Eternal Son, and Holy Spirit, ever One, Vouchsafe to bring us by Thy grace to see Thy glory face to face.

authors.author: Chris Tomlin, Johann Michael Haydn, Robert Grant

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O worship the King, all glorious above, And gratefully sing His wonderful love. Our Shield and Defender, the Ancient of Days, Pavillioned in splendor and girded with praise!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: O tell of His might, O sing of His grace, Whose robe is the light and canopy space. His chariots of wrath the deep thunderclouds form And dark is His path on the wings of the storm.

verse.name: c1
verse.lines: You alone are the Matchless King. To You alone be all majesty. Your glories and wonders What tongue can recite? You breathe in the air. You shine in the light.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: O measureless might, ineffable love, While angels delight to worship above. Thy mercies how tender, how firm to the end! Our Maker, Defender, Redeemer, and Friend!

verse.lines: Happy day, happy day, When Jesus washed my sins away! He taught me how to watch and pray, And live rejoicing every day; Happy day, happy day, When Jesus washed my sins away!

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines: Now rest, my long-divided heart, Fixed on this blissful center, rest; Here have I found a nobler part, Here heav'nly pleasures fill my breast.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines: High heav'n that hears the solemn vow, That vow renewed shall daily hear! Till in life's latest hour I bow, And bless, in death, a bond so dear.

titles.title: O how much the Lord has blessed you!

verse.name: v1
verse.lines: O how much the Lord has blessed you! Blessed you with unlimited love. // When His children come in worship Father offers us His embrace. //

verse.name: v2
verse.lines: God has shed His grace upon you, Gifted you life everlasting. // And His promise is that through you His salvation will reach others. //

verse.name: v3
verse.lines: From Isa's word let us draw strength. "If times look rough, know I'll be there." // Matters not just where you are, My presence will accompany you. //
